# braintrust_project (Data Source)

Use this data source to get information about an existing Braintrust [project](https://www.braintrust.dev/docs/admin/projects). Look up by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing Braintrust project by ID
data "braintrust_project" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" # replace with your project UUID
}

# Or look up by name
data "braintrust_project" "by_name" {
  name = "my-ml-project"
}

output "project_name" {
  value = data.braintrust_project.by_name.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the project. Provide either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) The name of the project. Provide either `name` or `id`.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID to match when looking up by name. Set this if the credential can access multiple organizations.

### Read-Only

- `baseline_experiment_id` (String) The ID of the experiment to use as the default baseline for comparisons.
- `comparison_key` (String) The key used to join two experiments (defaults to `input`).
- `created` (String) Date of project creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of project deletion, or null if the project is still active.
- `description` (String) Textual description of the project.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the project.
